title: Man at Niagara Falls, 1949 Canada B&W Travel Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot taken on June 13, 1949, depicting a young man posing along a cliffside walkway near Niagara Falls, Canada. He is dressed in typical late-1940s casual attire, featuring a light-colored short-sleeved work shirt with chest pockets and tailored trousers. In the background to the left, the mist and cascade of the falls are visible under a bright sky, flanked by natural foliage along the riverbank.
